style: Avant-garde progressive chamber-folk art-rock, polyharmonic quartal suspension fields with microtonal pure-interval friction, 3:2 cross-rhythm pulse coupling colliding with double-time hallucination, clipped phonetic consonant patter with obsessive alveolar trills and front-rounded vowels, magnetic tape loops, optigan optical pads, talk box, vocoder, physical-modeling strings, granular swarms, choral counterpoint lattice with hocketed vocal cast, breathless hype delivery paired with deep bewilderment headspace, dry separation stemminess with cheap analog tape saturation, spring recoil, transient phase-cancellation glitches, resonant metal plate reverb trails, circuit-bent toy piano cascades, and detuned music box machinery clicking rhythmically against chaotic acoustic valve noise, creating a dense mechanical labyrinth of sound with complex architectural micro-intervals, unstable frequency modulators, and subterranean acoustic tremors.
lyrics:
[Intro: Magnetic Tape Loop Hiss and Optigan Optical Pad Drone]
[Physical-Modeling String Pulse begins with 3:2 Coupling]
[Spoken Lead: Bewildered, Breathless Hype]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
Every clock is leaking its minute-sand onto the wool rug!
Every key slips through the floorboards into the dark crawlspace!
[Vocoder Choir Entry]
We checked the inventory with a magnifying glass!
The shelf is breathing backward and shedding its pine resin!
[Verse 1: Granular Swarms and Subtractive Bass]
Where did the Tuesday go?
It vanished into a pocket of salt at the base of the stairs!
We tracked the missing coordinates across three missing maps,
And found only an empty coat hanging from a vacuum in the hall!
My left shoe dissolved during breakfast while pouring black coffee!
The milk turned into pure white static before it hit the porcelain cup!
[Pre-Chorus: Talk Box Guitar Interlock]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
Is the room sliding sideways or am I tilting with the floorboards?
The wallpaper is peeling off to reveal endless hallways of nothing!
Even my own fingerprints are wearing down into smooth glass discs!
[Chorus: Choral Counterpoint Lattice with Alveolar Trills]
Rrring the bell! Rrring the broken bell!
The heavy iron keys dropped down the greasy kitchen drain!
The black umbrella unribbed itself into a startled mourning bird!
Nothing stays nailed to the fabric of the day!
We are shedding our histories like dry skin in a desert windstorm!
[Verse 2: Optigan Accompaniment Loop and Tape Flutter]
Yesterday my own name rolled off the edge of the kitchen table,
And rolled under the vibrating refrigerator compressor!
I reached my trembling hand for it, but grabbed a cold shadow instead!
Every single possession evaporates precisely at the stroke of noon!
The photograph of my childhood home turned completely blank while I stared!
The faces of my ancestors are smudging away into gray pencil dust!
[Bridge: Jurisdiction Dropout - Bass and Drums Cut Out Completely]
[A Cappella Choral Hocket]
Where are the wool socks?
Where are the grocery receipts?
Where is yesterday's meager lunch?
Gone into the great gray un-making of the universe!
Where do the missing spectacles sleep at night?
Do they pile up in a subterranean cavern of forgotten eyeglasses?
[Drop-In: Physical-Modeling Resonator Strike with Spring Recoil]
[Guitar Talk Box Lead]
Why do I lose everything all the time!
It's slipping! It's accelerating! Look out at the horizon!
The gravity of retention has failed completely in this room!
I am holding onto thin air and even the air is slipping through!
[Guitar and Vocoder Double-Time Hallucination]
The seconds are tumbling out of my coat pockets!
I dropped the entire afternoon in the crowded grocery store aisle!
A phantom tide sweeps through my dark closet every single midnight,
Swallowing brass buttons, heavy belt buckles, and letters half-written!
[Verse 3: Granular Shrapnel and Circuit-Bent Piano Sparks]
The memory of my first pet evaporated during the second verse!
I searched my own teeth with my tongue and found three missing molars!
They fell out as vowels while I tried to explain the leakage!
Everything I touch turns into fine gray soot upon release!
[Bridge 2: Microtonal String Friction and Detuned Music Boxes]
And what of the invisible ledger where debts are tallied against breath?
The pages dissolve into translucent pulp before my squinting eyes!
Every pen runs dry of ink the moment the nib touches the margin!
We are writing our lives on water with invisible trembling fingers!
The very nouns we clutch migrate across the syntax while we sleep,
Leaving verbs stranded without subjects in a desolate empty grammar!
[Chorus: Full Ensemble with 3:2 Cross-Rhythm Collision]
Rrring the bell! Rrring the broken bell!
The keys dropped down the drain!
The umbrella unribbed itself into a bird!
Nothing stays nailed to the day!
We are shedding our histories like dry skin in a windstorm!
[Outro: Tape Loop Saturation Fading into Splice Clicks]
Lost...
Everything...
All...
The...
Time...
Vanishing into the porous floorboards of memory forever...
[Final Tape Stop and Long Spring Decay]
